description:
Found by live verification of #3949 (perf-databend-bulk-load-20261030) on origin/develop 525361b2f8 against datafuselabs/databend v1.2.881 (compose docker/databend, run under mocker 0.7.2) with databend-driver 0.33.6.

Reproduction: `uv run --extra databend -- benchbox run --platform databend:self-hosted --benchmark tpch --scale 0.01 --phases generate,load --platform-option host=localhost --platform-option port=8000 --platform-option username=benchbox --platform-option password=benchbox --non-interactive --output <dir>` with the stack up (`make uat-bring-up PLATFORM=databend`).

Expected: all 8 TPC-H tables load via stage + COPY INTO with dbgen row counts (lineitem 60175 at SF0.01).
Actual: every table fails: `Failed to load customer: argument 'method': 'dict' object cannot be converted to 'PyString'`, no rows loaded, run FAILED ('Required benchmark tables are missing or empty after load'). Log /tmp/live-verify-databend-tpch.log.

Cause: benchbox/platforms/databend/adapter.py DatabendAdapter._load_file_native calls `connection.load_file(sql, path, format_options)` positionally. databend-driver 0.33.6 BlockingDatabendConnection.load_file has signature (sql, fp, method=None, format_options=None, copy_options=None), so the dict lands in `method`. Calling with keywords `method="stage", format_options={...}` works: write_rows 4, quoted text `"b|c"` kept as one field, empty field loaded as NULL, literal NULL text kept as string (/tmp/live-verify-databend-probe.log). The unit fake in tests/unit/platforms/test_databend_bulk_load.py defines `load_file(self, sql, file, format_options, copy_options=None)`, which hides the mismatch. pyproject pins `databend-driver>=0.28.0`; check which driver releases have which signature and pass keywords.

Suspected symbol: DatabendAdapter._load_file_native (benchbox/platforms/databend/adapter.py ~line 410) and the fake in test_databend_bulk_load.py.
